summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly consolidated summary report under Japanese GAAP for the three months ended June 30, 2026, noting completion of an interim review by a Japanese audit firm. The report presents ordinary income of ¥3,907,543 million, ordinary profits of ¥1,117,934 million, and profits attributable to owners of parent of ¥809,427 million, with basic EPS of ¥71.77. No special-situation transaction or event is described; the filing is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms, amendments, or strategic actions to assess, and no risk-arbitrage or special-situations angle applies.
